mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.name AS creatorName, u.avatar AS creatorAvatar, r.type AS commentRatingType FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.creator = u.id LEFT JOIN ratings r ON c.id = r.target_id AND r.target = 'COMMENT' AND r.creator = #{userId} WHERE -- 核心逻辑：只要 rootId 是这个帖子，一律带走 -- 这就是你说的：rootId = 帖子ID, rootType = "POST" c.root_id = #{postId} AND c.root_type = 'POST' ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
